name: zmcp
description: Brain location and initialization guidance, with a reserved startup tool.

interface.longDescription: Provides Brain location and initialization links during MCP connection initialization. The startup tool is reserved and returns only 'to be defined'; there is no need to call it. A legacy ground tool returns local fixture data only, not live Brain grounding. Requires local execution and Python.
interface.defaultPrompt: What is Brain and where is its initialization document?
